title_en: Maksim has got a bad wife

lines.cyr: Море Максим има, бре, лоша жена,
lines.lat: More Maksim ima, bre, loša žena,
lines.en: Oh dear, Maksim has got a bad wife,

lines.cyr: туф, што е лоша, па мрзлива.
lines.lat: tuf, što e loša, pa mrzliva.
lines.en: tuf, oh how bad she is, how lazy,

lines.cyr: (Леле Максиме, ах Максим ти кутриот,
lines.lat: (Lele Maksime, ah Maksim ti kutriot,
lines.en: (Hey Maksim, oh dear Maksim, you poor thing,

lines.cyr: да не си максам бре, аман бре!)
lines.lat: da ne si maksam bre, aman bre!)
lines.en: are you perhaps a little boy?)

lines.cyr: (А бре, мрза се роди, мрза ќе пцоиса!)
lines.lat: (A bre, mrza se rodi, mrza ḱe pcoisa!)
lines.en: (Oh yes, she was born as a lazy one and will die as a lazy one!)

lines.cyr: Море метлата ѝ бре зад вратата,
lines.lat: More metlata ì bre zad vratata,
lines.en: Oh dear, the broom (only) stands behind the door.

lines.cyr: (Метла од три дрвца! Со три дрвца што ќе праи, а?)
lines.lat: (Metla od tri drvca! So tri drvca što ḱe prai, a?)
lines.en: (A broom with three twigs on it! What can one do with three twigs?)

lines.en: Oh dear in the midst of her dough she lost her headscarf.

lines.en: (That's why the whole village is laughing. She goes bareheaded
